title: FBI-UAP-D043, FD-302, Unidentified Aerial Object Observation Report, 2026

pages.description: A mountainous scene viewed from an elevated vantage point, with a white border framing the image. The foreground shows a slope covered in low scrub brush, dry grasses, and reddish-brown bare earth with patches of sandy soil. The middle ground consists of rolling hills and ridges covered in dense, dark green and blue-tinted vegetation, with lighter patches suggesting rock, dry grass, or trails. In the distance to the left, a flat valley or dry lakebed appears pale gray-white, flanked by faint layered mountain ranges that recede into haze. A bright circular light resembling the sun or moon appears in the upper right area of the clear blue sky, which graduates from deeper blue at top to lighter blue-teal near the horizon. A small dark horizontal mark is visible in the middle-right portion of the image over the hillside.

The image has a white border on all sides

pages.description: A wide mountainous landscape viewed from a vegetated hilltop, bordered by a thin white frame. The foreground shows brushy terrain with dry grasses, low shrubs, and patches of reddish-brown bare soil. The middle ground consists of rolling ridges and valleys covered in sparse scrub and chaparral vegetation. In the background are layered mountain ranges fading into blue haze, with what appears to be a flat valley or dry lakebed visible on the left side. The sky is clear and graduates from deep blue at the top to a lighter, yellowish tone near the horizon, with a few wispy clouds. A small bright circular light (possibly the sun or moon) appears in the upper right. A small dark elongated shape is visible in the sky near the center-right, above the ridgeline.
